history.summary: CSV DUPLICATE FLAG: this row ('Tashiding Monastery', Mangan) is almost certainly a DUPLICATE of CSV row 909 - there is NO Tashiding Monastery in Mangan district. The real Tashiding Monastery is at Tashiding village, Gyalshing district (West Sikkim), on a heart-shaped hill below Kanchenjunga. Do not merge blindly: confirm row 909 covers this temple and deprecate this row, or keep with cross-reference. THIS IS A BUDDHIST MONASTERY (NYINGMA), NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. It is a Nyingma (Jhang-Ter lineage) monastery, the parent monastery of Sikkim alongside Pemayangtse, founded in 1641 by Ngadak Sempa Chempo Phunshok Rigzing - one of the three lamas who crowned Sikkim's first Chogyal at Yuksom. Renovated and extended in 1717 under the 3rd Chogyal Chakdor Namgyal, and rebuilt in 1995 with state aid after earthquake cracks. 60-70 monks. The site was blessed by Guru Padmasambhava (8th c.) and holds Sikkim's holiest stupa, the Thong-Warang-Drol ('Saviour by mere sight'), containing a relic of Buddha Wod-Srung.
